entrypoint.reason: The active four-workflow topology uses the monolithic Auto Sync fallback: discovery and assessment execute as ordered stages in the same bounded workflow. The independent Assessment adapter is disabled with no allowed callers; no separate workflow_run dispatch or task-input entrypoint is active.

repository_snapshot.format: JSON document or json_document_store sharded document
repository_snapshot.purpose: Exact same-run output from script_discover_sources; the Auto Sync workflow preserves and digest-verifies this runner-local artifact before script_assess_sources consumes it.

repository_snapshot.purpose: Read-only historical baseline for parser/policy drift comparison.

remote_inputs.redirect_policy: final response must remain HTTPS on raw.githubusercontent.com

environment.other_environment_inputs: RUNNER_TEMP artifact root and the same-run discovery workspace only; the active assessor has no GitHub Contents API write capability and does not update task-queue checkpoints.

task_input.note: No independent task input is accepted in the active monolithic fallback. The typed predecessor is script_discover_sources within the same Auto Sync run; its runner-local discovered_sources artifact is digest-verified before assessment. The legacy independent task-input branch is dormant and has no enabled adapter or allowed caller.

repository_artifacts.purpose: assessment history snapshot; never committed to repository

document_store_side_effects: Assessment history, runtime, report, manifests, shards and staging are written only to the isolated runner-local artifact workspace.
The assessor does not mutate automation/task_queue.json or any repository document in the active monolithic fallback.
The later script_register_discovered_sources stage merges the verified runtime snapshot into rulesets/source_candidate_registry.json under the enclosing production lease.

protected_paths.sources/domain_sources.json: not written; assessment does not activate sources

publication_policy.method: After the independent assessment-artifact verifier succeeds, upload the runner-local assessment outputs as an immutable Actions artifact. The assessor itself performs no repository filesystem write, Contents API write, commit, push or source activation; only the separate registry-writer stage updates rulesets/source_candidate_registry.json under the production fence.

resource_contract.lock_scope_note: The active monolithic stage is covered by the enclosing Auto Sync production-pipeline lease. Assessment outputs are isolated runner-local artifacts. No per-URL task.assessment_checkpoint or logical/source-assessment-checkpoints mutation occurs in the active topology; script_register_discovered_sources later updates rulesets/source_candidate_registry.json under the same production fence.

dormant_independent_mode.reason: Retained legacy task-input/checkpoint code is not part of the current four-workflow monolithic production path.

execution_semantics.idempotency_key: No separate Assessment task exists in the active monolithic fallback. The enclosing workflow_auto_sync task is deduplicated by Watchdog; the registry manifest preserves the next_cursor_url for a later bounded batch. Automated cursor-driven continuation remains a separate unverified gate.
execution_semantics.retry_policy: Retry the enclosing Auto Sync task under the existing queue/lease/fencing policy. The current monolithic assessor does not checkpoint each URL into automation/task_queue.json; the next batch resumes from the last verified registry cursor only after the registry writer persists the completed batch.
execution_semantics.timeout_note: The monolithic batch is bounded to 100 URLs, 1 MB per URL and 10 MB aggregate. The independent task adapter remains disabled; no separate task lease or per-URL queue checkpoint is used.
success_predicate: Process exits with code 0 and stdout satisfies the reviewed output schema.
Runner-local assessment history, runtime and report pass scripts/verify_assess_sources_artifacts.py and digest/shard-integrity checks.
The same-run script_discover_sources artifact digest is unchanged before and after assessment.
Protected config and read-only baselines remain unchanged.
The later registry-writer stage persists only verified assessment results into rulesets/source_candidate_registry.json under the production lease.
execution_semantics.independent_verifier: scripts/verify_assess_sources_artifacts.py independently checks runner-local runtime/history/report consistency, fingerprints exclusion and non-activation.
execution_semantics.repository_writes: None by the assessor in the active monolithic fallback. The separate script_register_discovered_sources stage writes rulesets/source_candidate_registry.json under the enclosing production-pipeline lease.

dependency_edges.note: The four-workflow Auto Sync pipeline runs script_discover_sources before script_assess_sources. The exact runner-local sources/discovered_sources.json logical document and SHA-256 are preserved and verified in the same run; there is no separate Discovery workflow_run handoff or independent Assessment dispatch.
dependency_edges.input_snapshot_validation: The monolithic workflow hashes the complete runner-local discovered_sources logical document before and after assessment and rejects missing or changed artifact content.
dependency_edges.scheduler_enforcement: The Auto Sync YAML orders discovery before assessment and invokes the assessor without --task-input. The independent adapter is disabled with no allowed callers; the separate enqueue_source_assessment_task path is not part of the active workflow.

permission_boundary.filesystem: Active assessment outputs are confined to the runner-local artifact workspace. The assessor does not write repository files; script_register_discovered_sources alone updates rulesets/source_candidate_registry.json under the production lease.
permission_boundary.network: HTTPS raw.githubusercontent.com only, repository-bound URL and same-host redirect checks.
permission_boundary.github_api: No GitHub API write capability is used by the active monolithic assessor. It does not CAS-update automation/task_queue.json; the legacy independent checkpoint branch is dormant and non-dispatchable.
permission_boundary.protected_config: modules/uu.conf is immutable and outside this capability's write set.

dependency_contract.enforcement: The active Auto Sync YAML invokes discovery before assessment, preserves the exact runner-local artifact and verifies its complete logical-document digest before and after assessment. No separate workflow_run producer, independent queue dispatch or predecessor-bound Assessment task is active.

verified_success_requires: registry writer persists verified results under production lease
assessment_task_deduplication.rule: No independent Assessment task is enqueued in the current topology. The enclosing workflow_auto_sync task owns discovery and assessment; the script_assess_sources adapter remains disabled with no allowed callers.

retry_policy.identity: enclosing workflow_auto_sync task identity plus current production fingerprint
retry_policy.resume: The next Auto Sync run reads the persisted registry cursor after the previous verified run. The active monolithic path has no per-URL task-queue checkpoint; failed/unverified runs must not advance the durable registry cursor.
retry_policy.repository_writes: Assessment artifacts are runner-local. Only script_register_discovered_sources updates rulesets/source_candidate_registry.json under the active production lease.
